reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

vote_frequency.label: In this cached set only (the latest 40 House roll calls, not a lifetime record): 40 of 40. Yea or Aye: 35. Nay or No: 5. Not Voting: 0. Of 40 Yea or Nay votes where the Republican majority could be computed, 40 (100%) matched that majority (majority = the side most of that party's members voting Yea or Nay took; on average 210 members of that party voted Yea or Nay per roll call).

posts.text: Congratulations to @Jim_Jordan on his election as our leader. Republicans took a hard hit last week, but now it’s time to come together and get back to work. I’m ready to help Jim and our team speak to every voter we need to win the majority back in 2028.

Great meeting today with the East Texas Chamber Delegation. They unite Chamber of Commerce members across the region to champion pro-business policies and investments that drive growth. 

From workforce to infrastructure to thriving communities, we’ll keep delivering for East Texas. Together, we’re building a stronger future for our region.

I am humbled by the recognition by @NYMag for the work we are doing on AI safety. There is a lot more to do, but we are ready for the challenge. We must continue to innovate, but we absolutely can do it safely. 

Read more: https://t.co/FZJbzZ1ohA

Texas is the heart of American energy. This week, the first million barrels from President Trump’s Venezuela oil deal arrived in Texas, where they’ll be refined by Texas workers and help lower costs for families across the country.

@POTUS and his administration continue to secure major energy deals that strengthen American energy and help lower costs for families, a welcome change from the previous administration’s failed policies.

I’m relieved and thankful that my friend @RepKeithSelf is safe. Thank you to the FBI and law enforcement for their work to stop this attack. Political violence is never acceptable, and we will not be intimidated by those seeking to create fear and violence. https://t.co/v0frnKuj10

.@CherylHines on Fox News’ @OutnumberedFNC: for every person you see on screen, thousands work behind the camera. Our bipartisan bill brings those jobs back to the U.S., including to rural America. That is what this bill is for! https://t.co/HUFp2HQdlK
Details and how to apply: https://t.co/mBOH9nANus

My office is hiring an Artificial Intelligence Policy Fellow to help shape AI legislation and track AI developments in the private sector as Congress works to keep pace with the technology. 

Experience in AI, policy research, or national security is encouraged. https://t.co/PSRAYFYb8T

I joined @asp for a candid conversation on how government can address artificial intelligence the right way. America should lead in AI, and commonsense safeguards help us do that without slowing innovation.

Watch the full interview: https://t.co/XGOgPt2NlS

Proud to stand with @VP in the fight to protect Americans from fraud. Hardworking taxpayers fund these programs for those who truly need them, and it’s on us to make sure that money isn’t stolen by fraudsters. 

Here in East Texas, we’re backing this pledge and doing everything https://t.co/iDcyxylHHg

This bill is extremely important to send a message that American storytelling does not just happen in California or New York. It happens all over America, including rural America. 

More from @liz_elkind w/ @FoxNews: https://t.co/cX2HqKThg9

Last August, I stood at the Nova festival site, where more than 350 young people were murdered on October 7. We heard from a young survivor rebuilding her life. Three years on, the pain remains, and so does a desire for peace. We remember every life lost. I ask for your prayers.

Today I asked a Pennsylvania manufacturer if the tax code decides whether the next investment dollar lands here or overseas. 

Her answer: expensing means every dollar invested here starts paying back the same year. That's the edge we need against China. As a member of both https://t.co/O1E0SGmHqA

I waited tables growing up in Tyler, Texas at Mercado's, and went back to work a shift this August. So when a Memphis restaurant owner testifies his 30 employees are saving ~$1,800/year under No Tax on Tips, it's personal. Real money for work I remember doing myself. https://t.co/2NPePK4vxm

Grateful for the kind words from Chairman @RepJasonSmith today, but the real credit belongs to the 29 million Americans who no longer pay taxes on their overtime. That's what the One, Big, Beautiful Bill is about. https://t.co/7X9H6yEMFh

Turning American innovation into American power. Proud to join @Saronic, @VP, and Gov. @GregAbbott_TX  at the Port Alpha groundbreaking — 10,000 jobs over 10 years and more than $3 Billion in investment right here in Texas. 

America's shipbuilding comeback starts now. 🇺🇸⚓ https://t.co/0JSQu0K60D

Why American Film and TV Production Matters to the World:

American film and television tell the story of who we are, and what freedom and liberty actually cost. That's worth protecting, and promoting across the United States. https://t.co/dnvObUOEif

When the right opportunity strikes, you’ve gotta jump at the opportunity. 

The stars have aligned where we have bicameral, bipartisan support, and we have a president who is very supportive of this bill. https://t.co/Z2Il61oKvZ
5/ This bill is bipartisan, bicameral, and backed by unions, guilds, and studios across the industry. Read the full release and statements of support: https://t.co/0Z8w1GGE4L
4/ Texas is already ahead of the curve. Our state's TMIIIP program supports more than 59,000 jobs and $4.8 billion in wages. This bill builds a federal partner on top of what Texas already built.
3/ It covers every phase of production, such as principal photography, post-production, and visual effects, as long as the work happens here in the United States.
2/ It gives added incentives for productions filmed in rural communities and Opportunity Zones, and in areas recovering from a federally declared disaster, reaching every part of the country.

The Motion Picture, Television, and Entertainment Revitalization Act creates a new federal tax credit for American film and TV productions, so the jobs and investment that have been heading overseas start coming home. 🧵

If we want to keep American storytelling in America, we have to level the playing field, and that’s exactly what this bill does.
